## What is this site?

This site holds the **interactive diagrams** that accompany the SEES0082 tutorials. Each page explains one idea in plain language, shows the diagram from the handout, and then lets you play with it: change the assumptions and watch what happens to prices, quantities and who gains or loses.

New pages are added week by week as the module progresses.

## How to use the apps

- **Move the sliders** on the left (on a phone: above) the diagram. The picture and the numbers update immediately.
- **Tick or untick the boxes** to show or hide the shaded areas.
- **Be patient the first time.** The app runs entirely in your browser, so the first load can take 10-30 seconds. After that it is fast.
- **Nothing to install.** It works on laptops, tablets and phones, in any recent browser.
